summary: Iteration 19: Verified the slug migration on GET /api/clients, the QR button now shown on every client row, the chamber-rename fix for the 5s poll reset, and the no-op rename. Backend: 21/21 pass (new iteration19 tests plus iteration17/18 regression, run serially). Frontend at 390x844 as superadmin: every client row shows the client-qr-<id> button, including a client inserted without a slug. The QR images were decoded with jsQR and give <origin>/?klient=stara-ferma-ui, /?klient=kowalski and /?klient=marco-polo. Typing 'Poro' slowly and waiting 7s keeps the value 'Poro' and focus stays in the input. Save, reset to empty and cancel all work.
critical_code_review_comments: clients.slug has no unique index; unique_slug() check-then-insert can race (two concurrent creates or migrate_slugs calls). Consider db.clients.create_index('slug', unique=True, partialFilterExpression={'slug': {'$type': 'string', '$gt': ''}}).
migrate_slugs() runs on every GET /api/clients; cheap, but it could also run once at startup.
FleetCard.jsx line 148: the extra {} around the client-qr button is no longer needed (cosmetic).
Test isolation: running test_iteration18 and test_iteration19 in parallel with xdist (pytest.ini default -n) can collide on kowalski-a chamber names. Run them with -n 0.
seed_data_creation: Temporary clients 'Stara Ferma Test' and 'Stara Ferma UI' were inserted directly into Mongo without a slug, then deleted through DELETE /api/clients. Chamber names were reset. Final DB: only Marco Polo (marco-polo) and Ferma Kowalski (kowalski); kowalski-a chamber_names is {}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The welcome page needs a click on welcome-login-button before the login form appears. Run the chamber-rename pytest files with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist). QR decoding: inject jsQR from the CDN and draw qr-image onto a canvas.
